meta.title: Plan Gate
meta.description: Asks about real ambiguity first, then submits a plan, and only acts on files, commands or the desktop after you press Approve. Toggle it beside the composer.

pill.label: Plan gate
pill.onHint: On: action tools are blocked until a plan is approved. Click to turn off.
pill.offHint: Off: tasks run directly without a plan step. Click to turn on.
